verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same broken layout. The 'JOIN OUR CHOIR!' headline is tiny and smaller than the 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!' subhead, so the hierarchy is inverted. The white cloud shape floats on the white background as an almost invisible, meaningless blob, the photo has shrunk to a small thumbnail, and the original's text-on-cloud-over-photo look is lost. A has slightly more balanced left and right margins, while B pushes the photo close to the left edge, which leaves the row looking lopsided.
